root.title: Expense Categories

expectedOutcomes: Expense category data is accepted only when it belongs to the fixed category set.

API consumers can request category totals.
The web surface shows category totals alongside the existing summary.

computeCategoryTotals returns totals grouped by category.

The current balance summary remains visible and behaviorally unchanged.

expectedOutcomes: API layer exports or otherwise exposes listCategoryTotals consistently with existing expense API patterns.

Existing API balance behavior remains unchanged.
